title: OutcomeBound review council configuration v1
description: The optional file `.outcomebound/council.json` of a project, or `~/.outcomebound/council.json` of a person, that `outcomebound review council` reads: the reviewers that run when `--reviewer` names none, and optional settings the command line overrides. The project's file is read first; where it exists the person's is not read.

reviewers.description: Each entry is `harness:model[:effort]`, as `--reviewer` takes it.

lens.description: What the reviewers look at, as `--lens` gives it.

timeout_seconds.description: The time limit for each reviewer, as `--timeout` gives it.

budget_usd.description: A spend cap for Claude reviewers, as `--budget-usd` gives it: a number of US dollars as text.
